title: Network Flow and Systems of Representatives
digital_publication: November20,2018, not a new mathematical version
version_limit: The retained PDF was not re-downloaded from the publisher URL; no byte-equivalence claim is made.
metadata_access: Official publisher web search result and Crossref response support identity; ordinary publisher HTML curl request timed out once and was not retried.

reading.method: 180dpi original-detail Poppler renders; existing text for navigation only; no OCR.

proof_scope: Six complete local or relative arguments. External integral max-flow/min-cut retained. Section3 cut proof reconstructed from the printed network.
precision_notes: Multiplicity bounds are taken to be nonnegative integers (the print states only 0 <= alpha_i <= beta_i); real restrictions need rounding before applying tests.
Page80 incidence flow must depend on the representative assigned to that indexed set, not merely occurrence anywhere in the SDR.
Page81 incidence endpoint subscript normalized to the ground-element index i.
Cut values are at least the target, as in the printed inequalities.
